claims: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The NASA Artemis II mission launched from Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The rocket for the NASA Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. ET.
The NASA Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The NASA Artemis II mission carried four astronauts.
The NASA Artemis II mission was the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years
